[[File:NynaDye.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Morrigan Corde, after dying her hair to resume her role as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]]]
{{Quote|So&hellip;what's this?"<br />"Hair dye.|Ben Skywalker and Lon Shevu|<ref name="S">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
In the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], '''hair dye''' was used to change the color of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. It was usually a liquid contained in a bottle, with an instructional label affixed.

[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] also used hair dye to change her blond hair black when infiltrating the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="DB">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many individualistic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] dyed their naturally black hair a different color. [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARC trooper]] [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]] often disguised himself using various materials including hair dye, although his brother, [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], believed that certain colors did not suit him. [[Rex/Legends|Captain Rex]] dyed his hair blond and later blue. [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Commander Gree]] and several other clones dyed their hair red.

[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] dyed his hair once when he went under disguise as [[Keiran Halcyon]] although it took two attempts as he accidentally dyed it green on the first try.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] once used hair dye, given to him by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lon Shevu]], with the intentions of making Skywalker less recognizable during his [[Mission to Vulpter|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]]. Ben worked the solution into a lather in his hair, and after washing it out, had brown locks instead of his natural red.<ref name="S" />

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was known to keep his hair dyed a rich and lustrous black.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] frequently used hair dye to change her locks from black to blond, and back to black, while switching between her roles as both Calixte and that of Morrigan Corde.<ref name="Leg19">[[Legacy (2006) 19|''Legacy'' (2006) 19]]</ref>
